summary: Full-stack smoke and workflow testing completed. All 11 frontend routes render and dashboard/chart/official invoice preview work, but seeded-record action flows are blocked because list APIs omit record IDs.

critical.issue: Seeded account list omits _id/id; UI cannot submit source_account_id/target_account_id and virman flow cannot start.
Seeded product list omits _id/id; barcode result cannot identify product for stock adjustment (404).
Seeded integration list omits _id/id; Test Connection and Sync Orders actions receive an invalid ID (404).
Seeded order list omits _id/id; invoice conversion from the orders UI fails (404).
Frontend cannot reliably identify seeded product/warehouse records; tested transfer payload returned 422 after list IDs were absent.

minor.issue: Invalid credentials return 400 rather than the conventional 401; brute-force lockout after five failures is not implemented.
Responses project out Mongo _id without mapping it to an id field, violating the frontend contract and preventing seeded CRUD actions.

integration_issues.issue: Invoice table renders, but clicking the visible send button shows 'GİB'e gönderim başarısız.' because the seeded invoice has no id/_id in the list response.
Banking, stock, ecommerce, orders, and warehouse action buttons cannot pass identifiers returned by their list APIs.

action_items: Map Mongo _id to id (or return _id) in every seeded list response, while continuing to exclude raw ObjectId values; verify all frontend action IDs.
Retest virman, barcode stock adjustment, ecommerce test/sync, order conversion, warehouse transfer, and GİB send after the identity fix.
Add auth brute-force lockout and return 401 for invalid login credentials.
Use explicit configured CORS origins instead of wildcard credentials in production configuration.
critical_code_review_comments: get_current_user falls back to demo admin whenever no token is supplied, so every protected endpoint is effectively unauthenticated.
The backend hardcodes fallback MONGO_URL, DB_NAME, JWT secret, and CORS wildcard despite the environment-only configuration requirement.

GİB, marketplace sync, cargo, and cashflow behavior are generated simulations in code; these should be labeled MOCKED in product behavior or replaced with real integrations before claiming live connectivity.

success_rate.frontend: 92% route/preview checks; critical action integration failed

seed_data_creation: Created one TEST contact, one TEST invoice, one virman movement, one stock adjustment, one simulated ecommerce order/invoice, one cargo shipment, one warehouse transfer attempt, and 2099-01 payroll records during API tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All routes rendered successfully. Focus retest on list-response IDs and all seeded-record action buttons; remove or isolate test-generated records if a clean demo database is required.
rca of the issue: Seed data stores identifiers in Mongo _id, but list endpoints use projection {'_id': 0} and return documents without translating _id to id. Frontend consistently computes action IDs as row.id || row._id, yielding undefined for seeded rows. Actions then call endpoints with undefined/invalid path or body IDs, producing 404/422. Create endpoints return Pydantic models with id, which is why newly created records behave differently from seeded records.
